name: FINAL FANTASY CRYSTAL CHRONICLES Remastered Edition

achievements.name: Leave Tipa
achievements.detail: Choose a tribe in Tipa and set out with the crystal chalice.

achievements.name: River Belle Path
achievements.detail: Clear River Belle Path, the first dungeon, and take the myrrh at its end.

achievements.name: Mushroom Forest
achievements.detail: Clear the Mushroom Forest and claim the myrrh from its tree.

achievements.name: Mine of Cathuriges
achievements.detail: Clear the Mine of Cathuriges and claim the myrrh in the mine.

achievements.name: Goblin Wall
achievements.detail: Clear Goblin Wall and claim the myrrh beyond it.

achievements.name: Moschet Manor
achievements.detail: Clear Moschet Manor and claim the myrrh inside the house.

achievements.name: Mount Kilanda
achievements.detail: Clear Mount Kilanda and claim the myrrh on the island.

achievements.name: Rebena Te Ra
achievements.detail: Clear Rebena Te Ra and claim the myrrh in the ruins.

achievements.name: Chalice Element
achievements.detail: Attune the crystal chalice to the element a miasma stream demands and cross that stream.

achievements.name: Fused Spell
achievements.detail: Combine two spells in battle so they fuse into a stronger spell.

achievements.name: Myrrh to Tipa
achievements.detail: Bring a myrrh drop home to Tipa so the village crystal lasts another year.

achievements.name: Nest of Memories
achievements.detail: Clear the last dungeon and finish the caravan's journey.
